Name: Dialogue New Line
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This simple mod adds a special character for dialogue mods:

[b][size=5]¶[/size][/b]

This is the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pilcrow]pilcrow[/url], a character once used for indicating new paragraphs in text.

With this mod, adding a pilcrow to dialogue code starts a new line.

This has been tested to work in both English and Arabic.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
